title: The cache-aside helper reads local first, falls back to origin, writes back with elicited TTL floor 1 second
description: The blueprint ships a cache-aside helper (src/cache-aside.mjs on the applied fixture) that wraps a domain-origin call with a facade read. getOr(key, originFn, {ttl?}) reads local first via facade.get; on hit returns the cached value with source "cache"; on miss invokes originFn, writes back via facade.put with the effective TTL (elicited default 60 seconds per ADR-3202; floor 1 second enforced at this seam so a misconfigured project cannot ship a sub-second TTL through cache-aside), and returns the fresh value with source "origin". No upper ceiling is imposed by the helper; the Cloudflare KV per-namespace limits at https://developers.cloudflare.com/kv/platform/limits/ are the vendor ceiling.
rationale: Ratified in the Cloudflare round 6 spec (2026-09-06 section 5.1). Ships as v1.0.0 of platform-cloudflare-kv.
